content.text: Ticket t002 is a normal-priority bug: pasting a Google Sheets table into a note on Lumen web (Chrome 131) collapses the columns into one long line, and the customer says it worked last week. My searches found no other reports about pasting tables, Chrome 131, or table handling. The only related hits were unrelated tickets, such as t008 (PDF attachments failing to open on iOS after an update) and t058 (a school-district outage), which don't point to the same cause. I also found no recent-change notes or known workaround, and my tools don't include release notes or a known-issues list, so I can't confirm whether a recent change caused this.
